How do I book a tour on this site? | Choose your trip, pick a date and the number of adults, children and infants, add your hotel and pay by card with Book now. You are charged in Thai baht, and we confirm the booking by email or WhatsApp after payment, then send your pickup time the evening before. Private boats and groups of 10 or more are booked by quote on WhatsApp.
Which currency will I be charged in? | Thai baht (THB), always. Prices in EUR or USD are shown for reference only and converted from THB, so the final amount on your card statement depends on your bank's exchange rate and fees. The Pig Island speedboat tour, for example, is charged as 1,450 THB per adult in 2026. Refunds are also made in THB to the same card.
When will my booking be confirmed? | After payment, we confirm every booking by email or WhatsApp, during our working hours of 08:00 to 20:00 Thailand time every day. Your pickup time follows the evening before the trip. Each booking is checked by a person against boat space, pickup routes and the sea forecast before we confirm it.
Until when can I book a tour for tomorrow? | Online booking for tomorrow closes at midnight Thailand time (ICT, UTC+7), so a Saturday trip must be paid before 00:00 on Friday night. There is no same-day online booking: for a trip today, message us on WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 and we will tell you whether a seat and a pickup are still possible.
Which payment methods do you accept? | We accept major credit and debit cards, plus Apple Pay and Google Pay where your device supports them, through a secure checkout run by Stripe. We never see or store your full card number. For quotes, such as private boats or groups, we send a secure payment link. Park and island fees are separate and paid in cash on the day.
How do child and infant prices work? | Adults are 12 and over, children are 3 to 11 and infants 0 to 2 travel free but must be included in the booking. The Ang Thong speedboat tour, for example, costs 1,800 THB per adult and 1,400 THB per child in 2026. Children's life jackets are provided on every boat and must be worn on board.
~Can I book for a group of 10 or more? | Yes. Groups of 10 or more book through WhatsApp +66 63 704 0888 rather than the online form, so we can keep you together on one boat and one pickup route. Send your date, trip, group size by age band and hotels, and we reply with a quote in THB and a secure payment link. For larger groups, a private boat is often better value.
What is your cancellation policy for day tours? | Full refund if you cancel 48 hours or more before departure, 50% refund at 24 to 48 hours, and no refund under 24 hours or for a no-show. This covers Pig Island, Koh Tao, party boats and private boats. If we cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date. The full rules are on our terms page.
What is the cancellation policy for Ang Thong tours? | Ang Thong day and overnight tours are fully refundable if you cancel 48 hours or more before departure, and not refundable under 48 hours or for a no-show. There is no 50% band. If we or the park cancel for weather or sea safety, you choose a full refund or a new date. The park is closed every year from 1 November to 15 December.
What happens if the weather is bad on my tour day? | The captain and operator decide on the morning, based on sea state, wind and official marine warnings, and safety always wins. If we cancel, you choose a full refund or a new date. Light rain alone does not stop a trip when the sea is safe. From October to December, sheltered south-west trips such as Pig Island from Thong Krut run more often than east-side trips.
Can I change my tour date? | Usually, yes, if there is space on the new date. Message us on WhatsApp with your booking reference and the date you want as early as you can, and we confirm the change in writing. If no suitable date is available, the normal cancellation rules apply, so ask before the 48-hour full-refund deadline to keep every option open.
Is hotel pickup included? | Hotel pickup is included from most areas of Koh Samui. Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao and Thong Krut (and other remote areas) add 400 THB per person, return. The surcharge areas depend on the departure pier, and the booking form adds the charge automatically when you choose your hotel area.
Which areas pay the 400 THB remote pickup charge? | For trips leaving from the east and north coasts, Nathon, Lipa Noi, Taling Ngam, Bang Kao, Thong Krut and similar remote areas add 400 THB per person, return. Pig Island trips leave from Thong Krut on the south-west coast, so the charge areas are different for them. The booking form shows the exact charge for your hotel before you pay.
When will I get my pickup time? | The evening before your trip, by email or WhatsApp. Pickup times depend on the route and the other hotels on it: Ang Thong speedboat pickups usually fall between 07:30 and 08:30. Be ready in your lobby 5 minutes early. If the driver has not arrived 10 minutes after your time, message us on WhatsApp rather than taking a taxi.
Is Ang Thong Marine Park open all year? | No. Ang Thong National Marine Park closes every year from 1 November to 15 December for the north-east monsoon and reopens on 16 December, so the 2026 season restarts on 16 December 2026. During the closure we run Pig Island trips from Thong Krut every day and the Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan trip when the sea allows.
Is the Ang Thong park fee included in the tour price? | No. The Ang Thong National Park fee is paid in cash at the park: 300 THB per foreign adult and 150 THB per child in 2026. Park staff use their own child age band, which can differ from our booking band of 3 to 11. Bring small notes: the fee is paid in cash only.
Ang Thong speedboat or big boat: which should I choose? | The speedboat tour costs 1,800 THB per adult and takes about 8 hours; the big boat costs 1,500 THB and takes about 10 hours with a slower, steadier ride. Choose the speedboat for more time at the stops and a shorter day, the big boat for a gentler crossing and a lower price. The VIP tour carries only 15 guests on a big speedboat.
Does the Pig Island tour run every day? | Yes. Pig Island trips from Thong Krut run every day of the year and can be booked online for any date, including November and December when Ang Thong is closed. The only reason a date is withdrawn is weather. The speedboat tour costs 1,450 THB per adult and 1,250 THB per child in 2026 and lasts 4 to 5 hours.
Can the boat drop me on another island after the tour? | No. Our tour boats always return to the island they left from, so you cannot stay on Koh Phangan or Koh Tao and skip the return trip. If you are moving islands, take a scheduled ferry, or ask us for a private speedboat transfer, which can drop you at another island's pier.
What should I bring on a boat trip? | Bring cash for park and island fees (300 THB per adult at Ang Thong, 250 THB on Koh Nang Yuan), reef-safe sunscreen, a hat, a towel, swimwear, a dry bag for your phone and shoes with grip for viewpoint climbs. Take seasickness tablets before departure if you need them. Koh Nang Yuan bans plastic bottles on the island.
~How do I get from Koh Samui to the Full Moon Party? | The easiest way is our shared return speedboat at 1,400 THB per person, with hotel pickup and drop-off on Samui and no ferry timetable to worry about. The next party is on 24 November 2026 at Haad Rin, Koh Phangan, the same night as Loy Krathong. The Haad Rin Queen ferry from Big Buddha pier is the budget option.
Do you sell Full Moon Party tickets? | No. We sell boat transfers only. Party entry, about 200 THB per person, is paid in cash at the gate in Haad Rin on the night. Our Full Moon Party speedboat costs 1,400 THB per person return in 2026, and online booking for a party night closes at midnight Thailand time the night before.
How do I get from Bangkok to Koh Samui? | Fly: Bangkok Airways flies from Suvarnabhumi to Samui about 20 to 25 times a day, taking about 1 hour 5 minutes, at roughly 2,800 to 6,800 THB one way. Cheaper options are a low-cost flight to Surat Thani plus coach and ferry, about 5 to 7 hours in total, or the night train, bus and ferry, about 15 to 17 hours.
How many days can I stay in Thailand visa-free in 2026? | 30 days for passport holders of 60 countries, including the UK, US, Canada, Australia and all EU states, since 15 September 2026. The stay can be extended once by up to 30 days at an immigration office for 1,900 THB. Rules change often, so check our Thailand visa guide and your nearest Thai embassy before travelling.
Do I need the TDAC arrival card? | Yes. Every foreign visitor must file the Thailand Digital Arrival Card online at tdac.immigration.go.th within 3 days before arrival. It is free on the official site, so avoid look-alike websites that charge a fee. Keep the confirmation on your phone in case an immigration officer asks for it when you land.
Is there a tourist entry fee for Thailand yet? | No. A tourist entry fee has been proposed several times, most recently as a flat 450 THB in August 2026, but it is not being collected as of 1 November 2026. It still needs a public hearing, Cabinet approval and publication in the Royal Gazette. The only form you must complete before arrival is the free TDAC arrival card.
How safe is Koh Samui for tourists? | Generally yes, and for most visitors the main risks are the roads and the sea rather than crime. Scooter crashes are common on steep, wet roads, and rip currents close Chaweng and Lamai beaches with red flags from October to December. Wear a helmet, ride only with a valid licence and swim where lifeguards or locals do.
Which numbers do I call in an emergency on Koh Samui? | Call 1669 for an ambulance, 191 for police, 1155 for the Tourist Police, who speak English and answer 24 hours a day, and 199 for fire. Several private hospitals in Chaweng and Bophut run 24-hour emergency departments. Save these numbers before you take a scooter or boat trip, and tell your hotel if you need help.
Are boat trips suitable for children and non-swimmers? | Yes. Children's life jackets are provided on every boat and must be worn on board, and non-swimmers can snorkel in a life jacket or stay on the boat or beach. Infants under 3 travel free. For young children, the Pig Island tour is the easiest choice: short crossings, sheltered water from Thong Krut and a half-day length of 4 to 5 hours.
Is there a jellyfish risk when swimming off Koh Samui? | Yes, small but real. Box jellyfish have caused 9 of Thailand's 10 recorded deaths since 2002 in waters off Samui and Koh Phangan. If someone is stung, pour vinegar on the sting for at least 30 seconds, do not rub it or rinse with fresh water, and call 1669. Many hotels keep vinegar stations on the beach.
